name: Night Owl
description: Tends to stay up late at night. Has a random chance to lose 10 energy (and rarely 1 Mood) every turn due to lack of sleep.

name: Slacker
description: 'I'm sure taking a break today is fine...' Has a random chance to not show up for training.

name: Skin Outbreak
description: Worries about her complexion. Has a random chance to lose 1 Mood level every turn.

name: Slow Metabolism
description: Ate too much and put on some weight. Speed cannot be raised through training.

name: Migraine
description: Feels a little melancholic due to migraine. Mood level can't be raised.

name: Practice Poor
description: 'Whoops! Watch your step!' Training fail rate is increased by 2%.

name: Fast Learner
description: 'Such a fast learner!' The SP cost of all skills is discounted by 10%.

name: Charming ○
description: 'Training together is fun!' Bond gain with support cards is increased by 2.

name: Hot Topic
description: 'Outstanding! The academy is proud of you!' Bond gain with NPCs is increased by 2.

name: Practice Perfect ○
description: 'Don't get careless when practicing.' Training fail rate is decreased by 2%.

name: Practice Perfect ◎
description: 'Let's be thorough about working towards a successful tomorrow.' Training fail rate is decreased by 4%.

name: Under the Weather
description: Exhausted both physically and mentally due to unknown reasons. Training fail rate is increased by 5% until autumn.

name: Shining Brightly
description: Physically and mentally in top form! Training fail rate is decreased by 5%.

name: Fan Promise (Hokkaido)
description: Gain strength by reuniting with your fans. Win a race held at the Sapporo or Hakodate racetrack to gain 10 Speed and Guts, 1 Mood level, 10 Skill Points, and a level 5 hint for the respective racetrack green skill.

name: Fan Promise (Hokuto)
description: Gain strength by reuniting with your fans. Win a race held at the Fukushima, Niigata, or Morioka racetracks to gain 10 Speed and Stamina, 1 Mood level, 10 Skill Points, and a level 5 hint for the respective racetrack green skill.

name: Fan Promise (Nakayama)
description: Gain strength by reuniting with your fans. Win a race held at the Nakayama or Funabashi racetracks to gain 10 Power and Guts, 1 Mood level, 10 Skill Points, and a level 5 hint for the respective racetrack green skill.

name: Fan Promise (Kansai)
description: Gain strength by reuniting with your fans. Win a race held at the Kyoto or Hanshin racetrack to gain 10 Stamina and Wisdom, 1 Mood level, 10 Skill Points, and a level 5 hint for the respective racetrack green skill.

name: Fan Promise (Kokura)
description: Gain strength by reuniting with your fans. Win a race held at the Kokura racetrack to gain 10 Stamina and Guts, 1 Mood level, 10 Skill Points, and a level 5 hint for the respective racetrack green skill.

name: Not Ready
description: 'I haven't been able to get into the flow yet...' Has a random chance to lose 5 energy after participating in a race.

name: Legs of Glass
description: Can shine in objective races as long as not afflicted by the Bad Practice condition, but will build up fatigue in her legs if racing continuously. Participating in a race two turns in a row will cause the loss of 10 energy and trigger the Bad Practice condition. Doesn't apply if the second race is an objective race.

name: Ominous Portent
description: Disturbed qi flow makes it easier for bad things to happen. Winning races becomes difficult.

name: Idol's Promise (Kawasaki)
description: Gain strength by reuniting with your fans. Win a race held at the Kawasaki racetrack to gain 10 Power and Wisdom, 1 Mood level, 10 Skill Points, and a level 5 hint for the respective racetrack green skill.

name: Hero's Brilliance
description: Head into the race for the final crown exuding the unmistakable determination of a true hero Temporarily raises all stats by ~350 for the duration of the Senior year Arima Kinen only.

name: Bud Longing for Spring
description: Your legs cannot yet withstand the strain of racing, so participating in races may lead to exhaustion Energy has a chance to decrease by 5 after each race.

name: Pure Passion: Team Sirius
description: Can carry out Friendship Training with Team Sirius and is immune to Insomnia as well as Lazy Habit.

name: Pure Passion: Heirs to the Throne
description: Can carry out Friendship Training with The Throne's Assemblage and is immune to Insomnia and Lazy Habit.

name: Pure Passion: Progenitors and Guides
description: Can carry out Friendship Training with Ancestors & Guides and is immune to Insomnia and Lazy Habit.
